states.label: Not sure
states.meaning: The current practice is not known.

states.label: Not in place
states.meaning: The protective practice is absent in relevant situations.

states.label: Partly / inconsistently
states.meaning: The practice is present only for some relevant accounts, devices or situations.

states.label: Consistently in place
states.meaning: The practice is applied consistently in relevant situations.

states.label: Checked or tested
states.meaning: The practice has been checked or tested recently.

states.label: Not applicable
states.meaning: The item is genuinely irrelevant to the person's situation; a rationale is required.

items.prompt: Important accounts use unique passwords or passkeys rather than reused passwords.
items.recommended_action: Start with primary email and banking; remove reused passwords.

items.prompt: A password manager or equivalent safe method is used for passwords that must be stored.
items.recommended_action: Adopt protected password storage and secure its account.

items.prompt: Multi-factor or phishing-resistant authentication is enabled on important accounts where available.
items.recommended_action: Enable passkeys or strong MFA on high-impact accounts first.

items.prompt: Recovery channels, recovery codes and active sessions are current and under my control.
items.recommended_action: Review recovery channels and remove obsolete sessions and devices.

items.prompt: Phones and computers use a screen lock and are not left openly accessible.
items.recommended_action: Enable a suitable device lock and reasonable auto-lock delay.

items.prompt: Operating systems, browsers and important apps receive security updates promptly.
items.recommended_action: Enable automatic updates where suitable and install outstanding security updates.

items.prompt: Built-in security protections are enabled and I know if a device is no longer supported.
items.recommended_action: Check security settings and identify unsupported devices.

items.prompt: Old, lost or sold devices are removed from important accounts and handled securely.
items.recommended_action: Review trusted-device lists and securely erase devices before transfer.

items.prompt: Important photos, documents and other data have a backup outside the primary device.
items.recommended_action: Back up the data you would most regret losing to a separate protected location.

items.prompt: I have verified that at least one important backup can actually be restored.
items.recommended_action: Restore a sample file or backup and note what worked.

items.prompt: Sensitive files and cloud storage are protected by appropriate account and sharing controls.
items.recommended_action: Review cloud sharing links, permissions and account protection.

items.prompt: I avoid keeping passwords, recovery codes or sensitive secrets in openly readable notes or messages.
items.recommended_action: Move exposed secrets to protected storage and remove unnecessary copies.

items.prompt: Unexpected urgency, secrecy or emotional pressure makes me pause before acting.
items.recommended_action: Use a deliberate pause rule for requests involving money or credentials.

items.prompt: For important actions I open the official service myself instead of trusting a message link.
items.recommended_action: Navigate independently to the known official service for banking and account changes.

items.prompt: Unusual requests from known people or organisations are verified through another channel.
items.recommended_action: Use a separately known contact method before acting.

items.prompt: I do not install remote-access software or share verification codes because an unsolicited caller or message tells me to.
items.recommended_action: Treat unsolicited remote-access or code-sharing requests as a stop condition.

items.prompt: My home router/Wi-Fi uses current security settings and a non-default administrative credential.
items.recommended_action: Review router admin credentials, update status and wireless security mode.

items.prompt: I avoid saving passwords or leaving sessions open on shared or public devices.
items.recommended_action: Do not save credentials and sign out fully on shared devices.

items.prompt: I periodically review app permissions and remove access that is not needed.
items.recommended_action: Review location, contacts, microphone, camera and account permissions.

items.prompt: I use protective DNS or equivalent network protection where appropriate and available.
items.recommended_action: Consider a reputable protective DNS or equivalent network protection appropriate to your environment.

items.prompt: I know the first actions to take if an important account is compromised.
items.recommended_action: Write a short recovery order: regain control, change or revoke credentials and review recovery settings.

items.prompt: I know how to revoke old sessions, devices or credentials after suspected compromise.
items.recommended_action: Locate session/device management for your primary email before you need it.

items.prompt: I know where to report cyber incidents or fraud and when financial loss also requires contacting my bank or police.
items.recommended_action: Save official reporting and bank contact paths before an incident.

items.prompt: After a security incident I review what else may be affected instead of fixing only the visible symptom.
items.recommended_action: Check linked accounts, recovery channels, payment methods and affected devices.
